# spacelift_space (List Resource)

Lists every space in the account.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_child_spaces` (Boolean) With `parent_space_id`, also list the children's own child spaces, at any depth.
- `labels` (List of String) Only list spaces that have all of these labels.
- `name` (String) Only list spaces whose name matches this pattern. `*` matches any characters, and case is ignored.
- `parent_space_id` (String) Only list the child spaces of this space.
